# Write-up of the cohort run, with the plate map and the calls we will not repeat

The November cohort is the one we keep. The plate map sits with the calls, and the calls we will not repeat are marked in the table below.

- Plate A, rows 1–4, the calls that held
- Plate B, the calls we will not repeat
- The blank wells stay blank

```
plate  call   keep
A1     north  yes
B3     south  no
```
